title: Initial local state
statement: Let $D$ be a finite, nonempty label set, and let an input consist of a finite randomized constraint satisfaction problem on $n$ variables together with a marginal probability law on $D$ for each variable. Its initial local state has those same marginal laws, assigns every variable one fixed label from $D$, and records zero work.
